attempts.rationale: The series is trend-dominated with unstable rankings; a weighted combination using inverse error should adapt to varying model strengths.

test a robust median combination to see if it outperforms weighted and DBA given trend dominance and unstable ranking.

Try a simple mean combination on the full pool to see if robustness beats weighted schemes in this trend-dominated, unstable‑ranking series.
The series has a strong trend and unstable ranking; a robust trimmed mean might reduce influence of outlier models.

The series has a strong trend and unstable ranking; a robust weighted combination on a smaller, more diverse pool might improve over full‑pool weighted.

decision.justification: Selected 'dba' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9904. Series context: trend strength 0.9595 and seasonal strength 0.4048; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.099); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.427.
